docs: `#[ephemeral]` adds the instruction the delegation program calls to hand
delegated accounts back to this program when they are undelegated.

accounts.name: vrf_program_identity
docs: Scoped VRF identity PDA, bound to this program. Its presence as a signer proves
the callback was issued by the VRF program for this program.

accounts.name: game
docs: Only while a hand is waiting for its cards. A late answer (say, to a
request made before the game was undelegated) must not re-deal a hand
that's already being played.

accounts.name: deck
docs: `pending`: answers only a request that's still open (undelegate
clears it).

accounts.name: table
docs: Only before the opponent joins: after that, both stakes are locked.

instructions.name: close_refunded
docs: After a refund that left the game on the rollup, once it's back.

accounts.name: game
docs: `Account` checks that this program owns the Game, so this fails while
it's still delegated.

accounts.name: mint
docs: Only USDC: any other mint could be fake, or a Token-2022 mint whose
extensions let its owner drain or freeze the vault.

accounts.name: vault
docs: The Table PDA's token account for `mint`. `init_if_needed`: anyone can
create an ATA, so `init` would let them block this table in advance.

accounts.name: game
docs: makes sure init_game already ran. After this instruction the
delegation program owns it on Solana and the rollup holds a copy.

accounts.name: payer
docs: Either player: the app has the opponent send it with join_table, so
the match starts without the creator coming back. Paid back from the
rent the creator pre-paid into the Table.

accounts.name: table
docs: Only once both stakes are in the vault.

accounts.name: game_permission
docs: permission program). Seeds pin the address: otherwise a player could
pass an existing permission (e.g. Game's in every slot) and the loop
below would skip creating the real ones, leaving those accounts public.

accounts.name: opponent
docs: The named opponent, or on an open table whoever holds the invite link.

accounts.name: invite
docs: Open tables only: the invite link's keypair, co-signing the join.

instructions.name: refund
docs: After the table's deadline, if the match was never settled.

accounts.name: game
docs: Only once start_hand has posted the blinds, and only once per hand:
no reshuffling after seeing your hole cards.

accounts.name: oracle_queue
docs: route the request to an oracle they run (and know the deck in advance).

instructions.name: set_session_key
docs: Signed by the player's wallet; the key can then sign the match's moves.

instructions.name: settle
docs: After undelegate_game, once the match has a winner.

accounts.name: game
docs: `Account` checks that this program owns the Game. While it's delegated
the delegation program owns it, and Solana's copy is out of date, so
settling fails until the game has been undelegated.
Game, Deck and Hands are closed; their rent goes to the creator.

accounts.name: winner_token
docs: The winner's token account; checked against `game.winner` below.

accounts.name: creator
docs: Paid for the table, vault and game accounts, so gets their rent back.

accounts.name: player
docs: The player's wallet or session key.

accounts.name: game
docs: `permissions_ready`: a secret written before init_permissions would sit
in a public account. The shuffle needs both secrets, so this also keeps
cards from being dealt before the accounts are private.

accounts.name: hand
docs: Only the signer's own Hand: the seeds pin it to this game, and the
constraint to the seat the signer plays for.

accounts.name: payer
docs: A player's wallet or session key: the tab can bring the game back
without a wallet prompt.

accounts.name: game
docs: Only once the match is over, or once its deadline has passed (checked
in the handler). Earlier, a player who is behind could undelegate
between hands (nothing burns a hand), wait while the other re-delegates,
and repeat until the refund deadline splits the stakes 50/50. After the
deadline the match is refundable anyway, and undelegating lets
close_refunded recover the rent. A stuck VRF answer is handled by
claim_timeout, and a dead rollup by refund.

types.name: Action
docs: What the player whose turn it is wants to do.

types.name: Deck
docs: The shuffled deck for the current hand. Lives at ["deck", game].
Separate from Game so that on the private rollup it can be made readable
by nobody, while Game stays readable by both players.

fields.name: cards
docs: Card ids (see poker.rs) in dealing order. Only meaningful once `shuffled`.

fields.name: shuffled
docs: Set by the VRF callback; cleared when a new shuffle is requested.

fields.name: pending
docs: A shuffle was requested and the VRF callback hasn't arrived yet.

fields.name: next
docs: Index of the next card to deal from `cards` (hole cards use 0..4).

types.name: Game
docs: Live match state (chips, pot, cards, whose turn). Created on Solana, then
delegated to the rollup while hands are played. Lives at ["game", table].
Kept separate from `Table` so the escrow never leaves Solana.

fields.name: players
docs: [creator, opponent], copied from the Table so instructions running on
the rollup can check who's playing without reading the Table on Solana.
Every [_; 2] below uses the same order.

fields.name: session_keys
docs: Each player's session key (Pubkey::default() = none), set by
set_session_key. It can sign everything that plays the match on the
rollup, so the wallet isn't asked to sign every action. It can't
touch the stakes: everything on Solana still needs the wallet.

fields.name: hand_number
docs: 0 before the first hand, 1..=6 during the match, 7+ for sudden death.

fields.name: permissions_ready
docs: Set by init_permissions. Until then every account on the private
rollup is public, so no secrets (and therefore no cards) before it.

fields.name: checked_in
docs: Set by check_in: this player's client is at the table. No hand starts
until both are, so nobody forfeits hands before they've shown up.

fields.name: stacks
docs: Chips each player has behind (not yet bet).

fields.name: bets
docs: Chips each player has put in on the current street.

fields.name: pot
docs: Chips from finished streets of this hand.

fields.name: dealer
docs: Index of the button. Heads-up: the button posts the small blind,
acts first preflop and last on every later street.

fields.name: to_act
docs: Index of the player whose turn it is.

fields.name: acted
docs: Who has acted on this street. A street ends once both have acted
and bets are equal; a raise resets the other player's flag.

fields.name: min_raise
docs: Smallest legal raise on this street: the big blind, or the biggest
raise so far if that's larger.

fields.name: board
docs: Community cards (see poker.rs). Flop = 0..3, turn = 3, river = 4.
Public by design: a card here is face up.

fields.name: shown
docs: Both players' hole cards, [creator, opponent], once a hand goes to
showdown. Cleared by start_hand. Folded hands are never shown.

fields.name: deadline
docs: After this (unix time), claim_timeout is allowed.

fields.name: match_deadline
docs: The table's refund deadline, copied so the rollup can read it. After
it, the game may be undelegated unfinished (it's refundable anyway).

fields.name: winner
docs: Index of the match winner, once there is one.

types.name: Hand
docs: One player's private hand. Lives at ["hand", game, player]. On the private
rollup only that player can read it.

fields.name: cards
docs: The two hole cards (see poker.rs). Only meaningful once `dealt`.

fields.name: secret
docs: Random bytes the player mixes into the next shuffle, so the VRF oracle
alone can't know the deck. Cleared once used.

types.name: Table
docs: One heads-up match between two players. Lives at the PDA
["table", creator, table_id] so both players' clients can derive it.

fields.name: opponent
docs: The invited wallet. Pubkey::default() on an open table until someone
joins with the invite link; join_table then records them here.

fields.name: mint
docs: The token both players stake (USDC in the app).

fields.name: stake
docs: What each player puts in, in the mint's smallest unit (USDC has 6
decimals, so 1 USDC = 1_000_000). The winner takes twice this.

fields.name: deadline
docs: After this (unix time), `refund` is allowed. join_table sets it to
the end of the start window, init_game to the end of the match.

fields.name: session_keys
docs: Each player's session key, [creator, opponent], named when they stake
(Pubkey::default() = none). init_game copies them into the Game, so
the browser tab that staked can play without another wallet prompt.

fields.name: invite_key
docs: Open tables: the public half of a throwaway keypair whose secret is
only in the invite link. join_table needs its signature, so whoever
has the link can join, but nobody can reuse a join they saw on chain.
Pubkey::default() when the table is for a named opponent only.
